displayPattern: Display on a Samsung dishwasher that is pairing with a phone: AP
meaning: Access Point mode: Samsung says the dishwasher is in Access Point mode so it can connect to a mobile device. AP is not a fault.
causes: Access Point mode was started to pair the dishwasher with a mobile device
diySteps: If you are pairing the dishwasher, finish that connection. AP is the pairing display, not a failed part
If you are not trying to connect it, turn the dishwasher off and turn it back on
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Do not take the dishwasher apart because AP is on the display. Samsung's step, when you are not pairing, is to turn it off and on. If a different code appears after that, use that code. Not every Samsung dishwasher has this pairing display.
sourceTitle: Samsung dishwasher is displaying an error code (Samsung Support)
